description: The roots mapping in .diffseal.json, read from the base commit: per root, the var-files to load in order and the workspaces it is deployed in.

cases.name: mapped var-files are layered in order and evaluated together; a shared var-file change that is fully evaluated needs no coverage review
a later mapped var-file overrides an earlier one, as repeated -var-file does: a name change there replaces the queue
the mapping is read from the base: a mapping added by the change itself is not used to review it
a mapped var-file that sets a variable no root it is mapped to declares is reviewed

reasonsContain: infra/vars/common.tfvars sets retention, which infra/app does not declare

cases.name: a pattern key maps workspaces for every root it matches, and only those environments are evaluated
a mapping entry that is not valid is ignored with a note

notesContain: .diffseal.json roots."svc/a": workspaces must be a list of names; that part of the roots mapping is ignored
roots."svc/b": varFiles must be a list of paths relative to the root directory

cases.name: a mapped var-file that exists at neither commit leaves that environment out, with a note

notesContain: .diffseal.json maps infra/vars/staging.tfvars for infra/app, which exists at neither commit

cases.name: a mapped var-file added by the change is a new environment: reviewed by name, not compared
with a mapping, a var-file below the root is evaluated only as mapped, and needs no partial-evaluation review
review round 1: a root new in this change that a base pattern covers is evaluated in its mapped environments
review round 1: a root moved in this change keeps the mapping of its old directory
